displayName: Streaming enhanced Netflix Disney Prime Video
description: Skip ads, intros, credits and add adjust speed, etc. on Netflix, Prime video, Disney+, Crunchyroll and HBO max.
name: streaming-enhanced

scripts.start-android: adb devices && web-ext run -t firefox-android --firefox-apk org.mozilla.firefox --adb-device 38091FDJH002WH
scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && tsx scripts/zip.ts
scripts.build:chrome: cross-env SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1234567890 NODE_ENV=production vite build -c vite.chrome.config.ts
scripts.build:firefox: cross-env SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1234567890 NODE_ENV=production vite build -c vite.firefox.config.ts
scripts.dev:chrome: cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development --watch  -c vite.chrome.config.ts
scripts.dev:firefox: cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development --watch -c vite.firefox.config.ts
scripts.transGoogle: jsontt .translation/deepl.EN.json -m google2 -n google2 -fb yes -cl 3 -f en -t de fr es pt it ja pl sv zh-CN ko tr
scripts.deepl: jsontt .translation/deepl.EN.json -m deepl -n deepl -fb yes -cl 3 -f EN -t DE ES FR IT JA KO PL PT SV TR ZH
scripts.hours: git hours -since 2018-02-01 -before today -author marvinkrebber@yahoo.de > authorHours.json && tsx scripts/hourstxtToJSON.ts
scripts.tstv: cd android-app/content-script && tsc amazon.ts --outDir ../app/src/main/assets && tsc disney.ts --outDir ../app/src/main/assets && tsc shared-functions.ts --outDir ../app/src/main/assets

author: Marvin Krebber
